detail.longDescription: Deploy Apache Kafka in KRaft Mode with Strimzi (2026) Updated October 2026 for Strimzi 1.3. The first version of this guide used Strimzi 0.48 and the kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2 API. Strimzi 1.x serves only v1, so those manifests no longer apply. Everything below was re-tested with Strimzi 1.3.0 and Kafka 4.3.1 on Kubernetes 1.36: the operator now comes from the Helm chart, which also makes the RBAC patches from the old version unnecessary, and the NodePorts are set in the manifest instead of patched afterwards.
